notes.title: VI
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="N0E4qEDcPHo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

Hear me, Death Warriors.[/p][p]The sixth circle of time has passed, and once again the memory of Death Crown rises.[/p][p]On this day, we, the keepers of the crown, bring you a new gift. Not an illusion, not a jest, but a true transformation: the black-and-white world has been stained with color.[/p][p]Since ancient times, whispers of the crowd branded the game: “its lines make eyes bleed.” I never heeded such words, yet a spark of curiosity long burned within me: what would become of the crown if color seeped into its darkness?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/425e4c98afbaab984579726cd71e341f7460ee03.gif"][/img][/p][p]We unearthed the old scrolls, the sprite sheets that slumbered in the vault of the game itself. I laid upon them the palette of Loop Hero, a treasure I revere, and began the ritual of recoloring. Sprite after sprite, for the original sources, once forged in Photoshop and stranger tools, were lost, and the remnants had crumbled to dust.[/p][p]Later, while shaping Era of Humans, I mastered another instrument, Aseprite, where layers and timelines stand like magical seals. With its aid, many images surrendered to recoloring more easily than in the beginning.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/58f9d30b68d581ea95524496c311d741fdc05002.gif"][/img][/p][p]Yet I confess: the result did not lift my heart. For the crown was born in the twilight of two colors, and new shades often broke its weave. Do not take this as canon, but as an experiment, an unanswered question, a scar between worlds: what if?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/2899edb8a019b8eb177d3940bbddab3090704d19.gif"][/img][/p][p]During development, we chose to separate the colored and classic versions into different builds. However, all saves, achievements, and other progress remain shared, so your victories will carry equal weight in both worlds. Our programmer worked especially hard on this, making sure the transition between versions would be smooth and effortless for you.
To enter the colored realm, simply select the corresponding option when launching the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/2302b1354ebebc55bbd1714582a4379f7676aaba.png"][/img]

Know this: in the true realm of Death Crown there are no colors. Only the white of the wastes and the black of the shadows. Only within this two-toned abyss does its essence truly awaken.[/p][p]And now, once each year, we, the keepers, gather again to leave you a sign.[/p][p]May victory be yours, Death Warriors

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/293310131cd53e5fb03a4a9755fd0934c16b199f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Vth
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/e163560b8b2f2b9ede6d3102b7c650a4cf7fbdde.png[/img]
Greetings, Death Warriors!

Another year has passed, and our ranks continue to grow, which is something that brings us great joy. For five years now, you've been supporting us, and we strive to return the favor. This game will always hold a special place in our hearts. [b]Death Crown[/b] was our first game, one into which we truly poured our souls. We hope you share our sentiments.

Although the time of active support for the game is long behind us, we still try to find time each year to bring you some small delights. This year, we've prepared a few small, but hopefully pleasant, updates.

1. We've added a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1444620/Death_Crown_Demo/]demo version[/url] on Steam (thanks to Valve for finally making demos more visible). Unlike the previous demo on itch.io, we've included a boss battle. So, if you have any hesitant relatives, friends, acquaintances, or any other people who are important to you and unsure whether [b]Death Crown[/b] is worth their time, make sure to show them our demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/f0d5db9d6790f83afbd1c97e68361f3770183974.png[/img]

2. We've also added animated avatars, stickers, and backgrounds featuring your favorite [b]Death Crown[/b] characters. You can purchase them in the Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/814530]Point Shop[/url]. Taunt your enemies in online games by setting a laughing king as your avatar, showing them just how superior you are.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/d5cf1455327b4a6e5b4b938dcb6f238858020760.gif[/img]

We find ourselves increasingly returning to thoughts of a [b]Death Crown[/b] continuation, pondering what it might be. A sequel or a prequel? Will it remain an RTS, or will the game change genres? Will it retain its black-and-white aesthetic, or will we introduce color while keeping the grim atmosphere? Will it stay in pixel art, or will we go 3D? What new features will we add, and which ones will we remove? We have so many ideas, and the urge to return to [b]Death Crown[/b] and surprise you with something new and stylish grows stronger.

I don't want to raise anyone's hopes too high, but I also don't want you to write us off. [b]Death Crown[/b] has never been about commercial success—we never had a meticulously planned marketing campaign or anything of the sort. Everything we did and continue to do comes from the heart. That's why your support is so important. Every mention of the game, review, piece of art, tweet, and, of course, purchase of the game brings the next [b]Death Crown[/b] game closer. We would also love to hear your thoughts and wishes regarding the continuation—what would you like to see in the next chapter of [b]Death Crown[/b]? Your feedback will help shape the future of this world.

notes.title: IV
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/e163560b8b2f2b9ede6d3102b7c650a4cf7fbdde.png[/img]

Hello, valiant Death Warriors!

Here we are, marking four incredible years of Death Crown. As time has swiftly passed by, what remains constant is the strength and spirit of this community. I'm genuinely humbled by your dedication to our game.

A sincere thank you to each of you. Your journey with Death Crown truly matters to us.

Let's touch upon what's been happening:

We might not have rolled out significant events or changes this year, but we've been diligently focused on making the game resonate with a broader audience. So, to all our Ukrainian, Serbian, Brazilian, Argentinian, and Portuguese warriors — Death Crown now speaks your language. We hope this small addition makes your gameplay just a touch more comfortable.

Ah, reminiscing about the past... Last year brought us face-to-face with that diabolical red fridge. And while I won’t spill all our secrets just now, keep a watchful eye on the horizon. The winds of change carry whispers of new tales, echoing familiar chants yet heralding unfamiliar adventures. Do you hear it?

Hold onto your crowns, warriors. The realm of Death Crown is vast and ever-evolving. The shadows ahead might be holding secrets, just waiting for the right moment to reveal themselves.

In the dance of time and war,
Death Crown Team

notes.title: Easy Mode and stuff like that
notes.notes:
Hello, Death Warriors!

Today we want to present you an update designed to make your life a little easier, especially for beginners. 

By popular request, we have added Easy Mode to the campaign. You can switch between Easy Mode and Normal Mode at any time on the map screen. You can beat the game 100% in Easy Mode. We have not added new achievements. 

Also, we have long noticed that many players ignore the free DLC - Era of Human. The Era of Human includes a campaign-prequel, which tells the story of the King, and events occur 100 years before the original campaign.

Now you do not need to add Era of Human separately, it will be immediately available with the original game. To do this, we have slightly redesigned the main menu, and all campaigns will now be in one Campaign tab.

I would also like to remind you that there is not much time left to wait for Demonic Menace. This will be a continuation of the original campaign, where you have to guide the demons and invade the Undead's Dungeon. The demons will come on November 12.

notes.title: FIRST ANNIVERSARY OF THE DEATH CROWN!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/93bca98fc07225c01a0d2191ab36fdfd23850ebd.png[/img]

Hello Death Warriors!

Exactly one year ago, Death Crown was released on Steam! And it's time to take stock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/38a6f25e37f3f860df15e6bf11b64c014981105f.gif[/img]

This pikeman gave the start in the development of Death Crown in April 2016. Thus, the game was developed by me in the evenings after work until January 2019, when we took up the game together at full time. Since then, the game has changed the genre, got a story, and we found a great composer who made the best soundtrack for us. So the game finally became the Death Crown that you know and hopefully love.

Death Crown is our first own release. Everything we did, we did the first time. Overall, I think we did it and we got a great game, albeit not without flaws. Thanks to the game, we met wonderful people and experienced gamedev as it is, with all the pros and cons, and we liked it!

Thanks to your support, we are still not discouraged and continue to make updates and improve the game. Thanks to this, we found a great publisher and the game will be released on consoles in November, and even more, people can enjoy it!

A couple of months ago, we launched a Twitter vote for a new faction in the game. The voting was very keen. The swarm and the dwarves kept pace, but in the end, the swarm got ahead! And we also found out that the elves' fan base is not very good.

In honor of the birthday of the game, we have prepared a small gift for you. With today's update, you can play as a Swarm in Practice mode and PVP mode! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/2681ea937438658e56bd3ad9058008246c48ea58.gif[/img]

We've also updated the Practice mode and PVP mode! We have brought the PVP mode back to the main menu. And now, when you select a map, you can see its preview.

notes.title: Take a look at our new ROADMAP!
notes.notes:
Hello, Death Warriors! 

It's been 10 months since the Death Crown release. Thank you for being with us this whole time! During this year, we've at least doubled the amount of content in the game compared to the release version of Death Crown in August 2019.
 
In September we added Domination, a game mode that allows you to compete with other players in skill. In January we introduced a brand new prequel-campaign called “Era of Human”, where you walk in shoes of the King – the main antagonist of the first campaign. This time you follow his story of how he started as a young warrior all the way through conquests and glorious deeds that lead to building the Human Kingdom. In the “Era of Human” campaign, we expanded Death Crown’s gameplay with new landscape features. We also updated Practice Mode and fixed countless bugs and made some improvements to the game experience.

We’ve been working on the new DLC-campaign “Demonic Menace” for quite a while now, and it’s almost ready, but we’ve decided to postpone the DLC release until Fall 2020. Don’t worry, we won't let you get bored and will do small updates during the summer!


In regards to this, I want to share with you our plans for this and the next year. Meet the new ROADMAP for 2020-2021!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/8188c40a47c16fba6edff549eecc9bef60840690.png[/img]

There's a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/814530/discussions/0/2573193396563420467/]FAQ section[/url] in the Discussions, take a look at it!

notes.title: New Bot AI, Death Campaign Update and something else
notes.notes:
Hello Death Warriors!

Today we have prepared for you several innovations.

First of all, I want to tell you that we threw our bot into a pit with snakes and he got out very angry from there. Now he is not so stupid and will be able to avenge you for all his defeats. The bot has become less susceptible to exploits. Yes, yes, now you can no longer force the bot to build towers at the beginning of the party and all that.

One of the innovations is that you have to break ALL the enemy Citadels to win. This fundamentally changes the gameplay of some missions.

We also added some of the mechanics of the Human Campaign to the original Death Campaign.

In connection with all these changes, we did a little rebalance of the original Death Campaign. We also tried to make a more adequate complexity curve. It is important to understand that the balance is not final and we will still work on a new balance.

Unfortunately, we did not have much time to redo the Domination mission, but we are going to do this soon. Once we are done with this, we will begin season 3 in Domination.

We also prepared a small surprise for you - a small demo of the new campaign!

notes.title: Warriors Update
notes.notes:
Hello Death Warriors!

Today's update changes the gameplay a bit, and also fixes some bugs.

[list]
[*][b]Your warriors no longer need to die if they have no purpose.[/b]
We changed the behavior of warriors leaving the barracks/crypt. Now, if the barracks/crypt does not have a suitable target for an attack, then the warriors just stop and wait for further instructions. New warriors do not appear. As soon as the barracks/crypt has a target, the warriors begin to move towards it. If you simply switch the soldiers from one target to another, then already released soldiers will run to the original goal, as it was before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/5c3954307dfc9f59b0265bc112fbfea4fb83391b.gif[/img]

[*][b]Now warriors move a little more randomly, rather than running clearly along the line.[/b]

[*][b]A bug was fixed when, after loading a campaign, or retreating on a campaign map, a character returned to an incorrect mission.[/b]

[*][b]Fixed a rare bug that breaks save after retreating in practice mode.[/b]
[/list]

Great victories to you, Death Warrior!

notes.title: New Practice Mode and Trading Cards!
notes.notes:
Hello Death Warriors!

I am very glad to tell you that Death Crown passed Valve's verification and we got Trading Cards! Now you have access to emoticons, badges and profile backgrounds! In addition to Trading Cards, Death Crown is now displayed on your profile and now you can show off your achievements in Death Crown to your friends.

And so that you have a reason to return to the game to get Trading Cards, we updated the Practice mode! Now, in Practice mode, all maps available in the game are available to you, and you can choose any map, and you can also choose a race (Human or Undead)!

Do not be alarmed by the disappearance of the Versus mode from the main menu, just Versus mode has become part of the Practice mode, which seemed more logical to us.

Thank you for your attention and enjoy the Death Crown!

notes.title: Free DLC - Human Campaign
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Qt69Jtgt9MY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, Death Warriors!

Today, we are finally happy to present you our first full-fledged DLC - Era of Human!
Era of Human is a prequel that takes place 100 years before the original campaign. You have to learn the history of the King, cleanse the primal lands of evil and unite humanity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/e3a8519337ce80a69c18934be00593291f12a632.png[/img]

The action of the new campaign will unfold on a new map. The Primal Islands is the cradle of the first people. Mankind, torn by internecine wars, does not notice the growing darkness. The Deadlord, commanding the hordes of the undead, destroys human settlements one by one and poisons the earth.

Cleansing the Primal Islands from corruption, you will encounter new evil bosses: the All-Seeing Tree, the Black Sphere, the All-Devouring Worm, and the Dead Citadel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/8752c9d9142e6a9676cc52043d37566f2a12060d.gif[/img]

20 new missions are waiting for you! Passing each new mission is graphically presented on the global map. The land cleared of spoilage will be filled with new settlements.

Fighting the Deadlord, you can take advantage of the new strategic opportunities of the landscape. On the battlefields you will encounter such landscapes as Forests, Swamps, Hills, Wheat Fields, Villages and Dead Lands. Each of them has special properties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/6f0a03db9128c48dd0561912ee54074ec528fecb.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Buildings cannot be built on the landscape with the Forest, but warriors can pass through the forest.

[*] Building on Swamp landscapes will cost you more.

[*] A landscape with Wheat Fields will bring additional income if you build a farm on it.

[*] The villagers will help you resist the undead, so building on this landscape will be cheaper. Also, residents will provide you with additional warriors, and if you build a Barracks, the Barracks will produce warriors more often.

[*] Buildings on the hills will have extra durability.

[*] All these features work only for Humans. Undeads troops turn all landscapes into Dead Lands. For Humans, building on a landscape with Dead Lands is more expensive. For Undead, building on Dead Land is cheaper.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/28bfb598f589bffcef56cf6165c56ccc92551d0f.gif[/img]

In addition to the new campaign, in this update we have added some tips and explanations to the original campaign. Now that you have improved your Citadel, you will know what exactly you have improved. New tips will tell you about such “hidden” features of the game, like demolition of your buildings, and an indication of the custom path for your warriors. The same tips will await you in the new campaign to explain the effect of landscape features.

We also fixed many minor bugs, and probably made a bunch of new ones.

Thanks to our friend [url=https://www.facebook.com/konstantin.knerik]ligh tn ing[/url] and his studio [url=https://ckz.wtf/]CKZ[/url], we got a cutscenes sound acting, and a couple of new battle tracks for this update. By the way, all the music and sounds in the game is also their work. 
You can support them by purchasing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231850]Death Crown soundtrack[/url] on Steam.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231850]Get DLC for free here![/url]

notes.title: Happy Halloween Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Happy Halloween!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/56713d1ef788c272ebf6d3dd7263ef7bb03f0ab6.gif[/img]

Today I would like to share with you some news about the upcoming update for Death Crown!

Firstly, in the upcoming update, a new campaign awaits you. It will be a prequel, where you have to play for the King of people and unite human lands and fight against the terrible Dead Lord. The action will take place on the islands on which the original campaign ended, but 100 years before them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/74b24e6d7a85352478e109f9e051632346c1c43f.gif[/img]

In addition to new missions and bosses, we plan to rebalance the races. Undeads and Humans will differ not only in appearance, as it was before, but also in balance, and even by some mechanics!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/3967ed09755e41382605a0100878bb950b6a6ef2.gif[/img]

Another innovation is the various landscapes that will affect your buildings. For example, making a building on a hill will increase its health, and making a building on a swamp will cost you more. Each race will have their own bonuses from different landscapes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/8486b2c345eca0bb5348abb1b34b48c5e365751f.gif[/img]

If everything is cool, then the update will be available at the end of autumn. Details of the new features will be available closer to release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/783cd080074786e5bbd3929f3bc5216603e11e4e.gif[/img]

Also, you may have noticed that Valve added Remote Play Together to Steam and it works with Death Crown too! You can play with your friend if he has a gamepad. Your friend doesn’t even have to buy a game for this. Just invite him, launch the desired mode, and when the game asks to press the button for the second game, your friend should press something on his gamepad. At the moment, the Remote Play Together function does not work brilliantly, but it's still a good opportunity to enjoy the game with friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/96ccaa322be154b1c1d31714e3e3a7f34f9436ea.gif[/img]

By the way, the Steam has a 30% discount on the Death Crown!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: New in Death Crown — Domination mode!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=pmOi8YkwpB4;full][/previewyoutube]
Hello!

Today I want to present you our new mode for the game - Domination!
In this mode, 30 new missions will be available to you.

Missions are arranged in increasing order of difficulty. 10th, 20th and 30th - missions with bosses. For killing bosses, your Citadel will improve, as in the campaign.

Passing missions you will receive black stones, as in a campaign. Black stones can be spent on the enhancement of the buildings, as in a campaign.

You will have three lives to complete all the missions. If you lose three times, then you have to start from the beginning.

But that's not all! For each completed mission you will receive scores. Scores will be awarded according to several criteria:

[list]
[*] Mission time
[*] The number of buildings destroyed by you
[*] The number of buildings you built
[*] The balance of gold at the end of the mission
[/list]

Scores for completing the mission will be multiplied by the progress rate. It means that for each next mission you will receive more than for the previous one. Then these scores will be added to the rest of the scores.

After completing 30 missions, or after three defeats, all your scores will be entered in the Steam leaderboard.

New achievements will be added for completing 10th, 20th and 30th missions.

I also want to warn you that the mode is not designed for beginners, and it is a real challenge. Be careful!

We also make a new balance of the Towers. Towers shoot more than once 12 seconds, as it was before. The Towers now fire once every 6 seconds. Improving the Towers reduces their cooldown by 1 second per level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32296087/9eb1bda4f2e078a5a894e37d68faca15c939becc.png[/img]

Also, we finally added a notification that your Citadel has been improved after defeating the boss in the campaign.

Stay tuned and enjoy!

notes.title: Death Crown Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello all!
I know that we rarely share with you the development details and this is very sad. The fact is that we spend a lot of effort on development and often it seems to me that we have nothing to share with you. This is usually not the case, but the moment has already been missed. I want you to know that we have not drop the game, and continue to work on it!

One way or another, today I want to share our plans with you before the end of the year. For this, I prepared a public roadmap.

In the near future we will release an update that will add a new mode to the game. The mode is called Domination, and 30 new missions are waiting for you in it, as well as a leaderboard. In the near future I will tell you more about it.
In the long run, we plan to release two new campaigns. A campaign of people and a campaign of a new race of demons.

Stay tuned, you are the best players in the world!

notes.title: Hotfixes! Missions have become easier!
notes.notes:
Hello! 
By popular requirements, we have facilitated the passage of some missions that impeded you from moving further. However, they still remained difficult, they are not impassable. But this missions require maximum concentration, tactics, and tracking the battlefield. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32296087/6e2015515838d4712f6e44b73119fd2d22ee8759.png[/img]

In addition, we left a couple of complex missions untouched, as they are not mandatory. But we now evaluate them for 4 skulls.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32296087/32234124b135a63da9697c33a19662c583c2d338.png[/img]

In conclusion, I would like to give a couple of tips for passing:

1. Play more aggressively! Try to capture crystals as early as possible, and don't get carried away by towers.
2. Do not be afraid of bosses! These are the usual levels, but with their own feature, guessing which you can easily defeat them!
3. Do not be afraid to destroy your buildings!
4. Monitor the health of buildings. This can be done by hovering over them.
